headline: MPS Limited files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: MPS Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) regarding substantial acquisition of shares. The filing was submitted to NSE on 19 June 2026, indicating a significant shareholding threshold event requiring public disclosure.
detail: MPS Limited submitted to NSE a disclosure required under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates that when a person acquires shares crossing a specified slab, the acquirer and target company must jointly file detailed disclosures with the stock exchange and SEBI, including the acquirer's identity, quantum of acquisition, intention (whether takeover or strategic), funding source, and any open offer requirement. The filing confirms compliance with public disclosure obligations but the specific parties, shareholding percentage, and acquisition value are not disclosed in the primary source.
